info.name: LTX Video
info.description: Local text/image-to-video with audio using LTX-2.5 on Apple Silicon (ltx-2-mlx). Start `ltx-api` first. Generation takes minutes: raise Postman's request timeout (Settings > General) or set it to 0.

request.description: Whether the gated pack is downloaded, whether HF_TOKEN is set, and whether the pipeline is loaded.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.name) pm.collectionVariables.set('videoName', b.name);

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "Waves roll onto a quiet beach at golden hour, slow pan right, gulls calling and soft surf",
  "width": 768,
  "height": 512,
  "duration_s": 4,
  "fps": 24,
  "seed": 42,
  "output_name": "beach"
}

request.description: Writes an MP4 (video + audio) to outputs/ and returns its path and download url. Stores the name in {{videoName}}.

formdata.value: the camera slowly pushes in as she smiles, soft morning birdsong
